title: Start with repeated work

body.text: Pick work you repeat that has clear steps, and write it as a Skill:
(1) state when to use it (2) list the steps (3) include examples of good output
. The clearer the examples, the more closely the AI follows them.

example: A 'Summarize meeting' Skill: use it when you have meeting notes → extract topics, decisions, assigned tasks → format as bullets

title: Test and refine

body.text: Try the Skill on several real tasks and see if results match. When it misses,
covering that case. Refining a Skill from real results makes it steadily more accurate — like training a new employee.

example: The meeting-summary Skill forgot to capture 'due dates' → add a rule: also state each task's due date

question: What kind of work should you start building a Skill from?

options.text: Work you repeat that has clear steps

question: What does a good Skill include?

options.text: When to use it + steps + examples of good output

question: If a Skill misses on some cases, what should you do?

options.text: Add a rule or example covering that case

question: Refining a Skill from real results is like what?

options.text: Training a new employee to get steadily better
